title: Actions for the successful handover report determination

entities.name: Successful Handover Report Determination
entities.description: Procedure where the UE stores successful handover information in VarSuccessHO-Report when specific timer ratio conditions are met or DAPS handover RLF occurs.

entities.name: VarSuccessHO-Report
entities.description: UE variable storing successful handover information including cell identities, measurements, and handover parameters.

entities.name: successHO-Config
entities.description: Configuration containing thresholds for timer ratios and DAPS failure reporting parameters used to determine when to store handover reports.

entities.name: Timer T304
entities.description: Timer used during handover procedures, with elapsed time ratio compared to thresholdPercentageT304 to trigger report storage.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Radio link failure detection timer, with elapsed time ratio compared to thresholdPercentageT310 to trigger report storage.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer associated with measurement identity of target cell, with elapsed time ratio compared to thresholdPercentageT312 to trigger report storage.

entities.name: DAPS Handover RLF Condition
entities.description: Condition where sourceDAPS-FailureReporting is true, last handover was DAPS handover, and RLF occurred at source PCell while T304 was running.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationComplete
entities.description: Message sent by UE to confirm successful reconfiguration completion, used as time reference for measurement collection.

entities.name: sourceCellInfo
entities.description: Information element containing source PCell identity, measurements, and DAPS RLF indication.

entities.name: targetCellInfo
entities.description: Information element containing target PCell identity, measurements, and conditional handover timing information.

entities.name: measResultNeighCells
entities.description: Information element containing measurement results for neighboring cells including NR and EUTRA measurements.

relations.description: Procedure stores successful handover information in VarSuccessHO-Report variable

Procedure execution is guarded by T304 timer ratio condition

VarSuccessHO-Report contains neighbor cell measurement results
